description: Eisenstein-Hu growth proxy calibration probe (NOT a full Boltzmann solver)
methodology: Eisenstein-Hu (1998) fitting formula + single-mode growth ODE + top-hat quadrature

epistemic_verdict.finding: Sound horizon r_s = 144.43 Mpc matches Planck. Growth proxy yields sigma_8 = 1.0247 (LCDM) and 1.0861 (dual gravity). Unscreened linear dual gravity enhances growth. A full Einstein-Boltzmann code (CAMB/CLASS) and non-linear halo screening remain open.
